name: adr183-continuation-native-4
result: Stopped at worker/handover (changed): after the guard bridge PUTs the workload guard to later generations, InitialPreparer.ReadHandover's final protection check reports a change. Run 5 uses the original installer input the resource producer verified under the handover at construction (InitialRuntimeResources.Initial) instead of a post-bridge handover read. This also identifies that a post-bridge replay of any ReadHandover caller (including the passive bootstrap hook) stops; recorded in ADR-183.
